mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (login_id, login_password, name, birth_date, phone, email) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{loginPassword}, #{name}, #{birthDate}, #{phone}, #{email})
mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, name, birth_date, phone, email, created_at FROM user WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
SELECT id, login_id, name, birth_date, phone, email, created_at FROM user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id, login_id, name, birth_date, phone, email, created_at FROM user WHERE id = #{userId}
